answer: An identity's reward for its second answer in an epoch is 36% lower than its first, and the curve keeps falling, with the schedule published as the thread. The prism curve is applied at settlement, horizon exposes the marginal rate, and the attestation weight of every extra key falls with it. Splitting work across more keys as a result yields strictly less than concentrating it, as a result a farm earns less than the same work done honestly. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
